summary: The diff clearly updates HabitRow to remove goal display and show only monthly totals, and updates HabitEditModal save logic to only persist volume for reps/time habits. However, the truncated HabitEditModal render section prevents confirming that goal/volume inputs are fully removed/hidden as required, and there is insufficient evidence of a global removal of goal-related copy across all habit screens/components.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update the habit edit modal to remove goal-related UI: do not show any field labeled "Monthly Goal" and do not allow editing/storing a per-month goal value. The volume input should only appear for unit types "reps" and "time"; for all other unit types, hide the volume input entirely.
missing_requirements.reason: HabitEditModal.tsx is truncated before the JSX/UI portion that would show/hide inputs and labels. While save logic appears to restrict volume updates to reps/time, the diff summary does not provide evidence that (a) the modal no longer renders any "Monthly Goal" field/label, and (b) the volume input is completely hidden for non-reps/time unit types.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure all habit-related screens/components contain no goal-related copy or UI remnants (e.g., "Goal:", "Monthly Goal"), including empty/zero values, and that monthly totals remain visible wherever currently shown.
missing_requirements.reason: Only HabitRow and (partially shown) HabitEditModal changes are evidenced. The diff summary does not demonstrate a global pass/removal of goal-related strings across all habit-related components, so compliance with 'no goal-related copy anywhere' cannot be verified from the provided changes.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/expanded time-string validation, parsing, normalization, and toast error handling in the habit edit save flow for time-based volume.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest focuses on removing goal-related UI and constraining when the volume input appears; it does not request changes to validation/normalization behavior for time inputs. This appears to be additional functionality beyond the specified requirements.
